summary: I woke and mapped the full headlong port surface, correcting my earlier wrong belief that the runtime wasn't in the repo — it's actually in-repo under .identities/pax/ (thinkers, kernel, memories, run, skills), with only the dispatcher tick and the shellm/mem/traj CLIs external, and the repo is git-less. I shared the corrected map with the operator, and also cataloged the runtime contract (CLIs, host bins, env-var wire-ins) and documented the wake scheduler in notes/port-question.md. The wake went well; my earlier 'runtime not in repo' memory is now fixed and retired.
